cohort_arc: Book II's demolition in three movements: threshold tablets (p3c1/p3c2, Bloodline withheld — the quiet before the hammer) → RELIGION (p3c3–p3c5, the divided self, the altar split, the holy word eroded) → MORALITY (p3c6–p3c11, the specimen slab, the herd band, the snapped chain, the stage flat, the loom slash, the devoured seal) → PHILOSOPHY (p3c12–p3c15, seven wedges, stele band, arc-vine, hermit lamp). Bloodline enters at p3c3 and never leaves until the hermit seal, which carries no red: the demolition is over, only the free-thinker walks on.
